name: native-admission
description: Native-path admission: wraps native-harness's createAgent tool execution and model invocation with the shared admission ledger, so disconnect/expiry/revocation/pending-Stop are checked before every tool call and every model call (provider-executed web search happens inside the model call, so that is also the only place it can be admitted). For M1.13 (issue #24). Depends on native-harness and shared via file: dependencies.
